subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For this exact head, should gateway maintainers require redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login proof before merge, or explicitly accept the focused gateway lifecycle regressions as sufficient evidence?
rationale: The contributor has repaired the prior mechanical review findings and clearly states that they cannot access a real WeChat provider session; choosing whether provider-backed behavior needs direct proof is an owner risk-acceptance decision, not an automated code repair.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup provides redacted evidence that adding account B leaves account A online through the reload handoff.

options.title: Waive live provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused gateway regression suite and normal CI as sufficient for this exact head, then proceed only after required checks are green.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup provides redacted evidence that adding account B leaves account A online through the reload handoff.
